description: This file defines the interface for the xarchiver GTK-based application, including widget declarations, enums, structs, and function prototypes related to the GUI and archive operations.

methods.name: process_gtk_events
methods.description: Processes GTK events in the main loop.

methods.name: select_matched_rows
methods.description: Callback to select rows matching certain criteria in a GtkTreeModel.

methods.name: xa_add_page
methods.description: Adds a new page to the archive interface.

methods.name: xa_block_signal_dir_treeview_selection
methods.description: Blocks or unblocks signals for directory treeview selection.

methods.name: xa_combo_box_text_append_compressor_types
methods.description: Appends compressor types to a combo box.

methods.name: xa_check_password
methods.description: Checks if the provided password is correct for an archive.

methods.name: xa_create_archive_properties_window
methods.description: Creates a window for archive properties.

methods.name: xa_file_filter_add_archiver_pattern_sort
methods.description: Adds file filter patterns for archiver.

methods.name: xa_flash_led_indicator
methods.description: Flashes an LED indicator, possibly for status.

methods.name: xa_increase_progress_bar
methods.description: Increases the progress bar based on current operation.

methods.name: xa_label_sort
methods.description: Returns a label for sorted archive entries.

methods.name: xa_pulse_progress_bar
methods.description: Pulses the progress bar to indicate activity.

methods.name: xa_set_button_state
methods.description: Sets the enabled/disabled state of various buttons.
